node.label: Inter-State disputes
node.summary: Boundary and water disputes between States and how they are settled.

facts.text: Odisha and A.P. police clashed over the **Kotia group of villages** in Odisha's **Koraput** district, which A.P. also claims, as A.P. planned local polls there on 5 Nov; Odisha cited a **Supreme Court status quo order (2006)** and filed contempt.
